purpose: Define the first practical R1 runtime scope that reduces Owner relay and clerical burden without expanding Source, network, scientific, financial, or external-contact authority.

why_now.goal: Move from audited one-shot execution to a small useful internal operational runtime while keeping all material data/science/external boundaries closed.

authorized_responsibilities: SOURCE_AUDIT_CACHE lookup and fail-closed state transition for candidate metadata/evidence already supplied to the task
RELIABLE_TASK_EXECUTION including duplicate suppression, idempotency, lease/fencing, checkpoint, retry, dead-letter, CAS/version preconditions, durable receipts, and stale-canonical denial
OWNER_EXCEPTION_VIEW generation for material blocks and failures without any approval authority
Routine successful task completion without Owner relay when the full Authorization Contract permits the exact operation
allowed_inputs: canonical repository governance and evidence artifacts
candidate metadata explicitly supplied to an R1 task
public URLs or source identifiers only as inert metadata strings
previously accepted Phase A public-terms audit records and Source Audit Cache state

runtime_state_write_requires: full Authorization Contract ALLOW for the exact operation
current lease owner and fencing epoch

execution_ceiling.auto_pause_condition: WHICHEVER_OCCURS_FIRST: 25 terminal tasks or 7 days from activation

explicitly_not_authorized: network or public-web research by the runtime
automated Source discovery or bulk collection
new spend, payment, procurement, or contract
model promotion or scientific lineage promotion
scientific scoring expansion including Segment C
arbitrary writes to canonical main or governance
minting, widening, downgrading, or reclassifying permissions
general full runtime activation outside this Stage 1 scope
required_pre_activation_evidence_if_appr: implementation built from Fresh Read canonical main on a noncanonical branch
dedicated Stage 1 CI covering allowed writes and all deny boundaries
negative tests for stale main, stale lease, duplicate task, lost ACK, retry exhaustion, corrupt state, forbidden path write, network attempt, and permission mismatch
exact scope and code head unchanged between final audit and activation
runtime state branch created only after the above evidence passes

owner_decision_requested.plain_japanese: R1を最初の限定実用運転へ進める。対象はGitHub内部のSource調査事務局（重複確認・Task管理・復旧・失敗隔離・完了記録・例外報告）のみ。ネット調査、外部連絡、Source採用、実データ/PRE、競輪の科学判断、RESULT/PAYOUT、holdout、課金、常時監視は許可しない。実装後にLabと独立AuditorがPASSした場合だけ、最大1 worker・25件または7日で自動停止するStage 1を稼働してよい。
